texts.cb2655d0e5d4:
The Data Recipient agrees to process the Data only for the following purposes agreed with the HSCIC: Objective for processing: To support contractual and strategic benchmarking across north and east London, for programmes such as planning commissioning and productivity, service quality and performance improvement, and activity and outcomes monitoring for local populations. Processing Activities and benefits to the Health and Social Care System North and East London CSU will use data for: 
• Supporting long term Strategic and Operational Planning, helping local CCGs by exploring better outcomes and financial efficiencies of nearest similar neighbours in demographic and service use terms. 
• Transforming Services, Changing Lives – a major service reconfiguration programme with a large NHS trust that requires in-depth analysis of whole trust activity (not just our CCG’s own patients) and evaluation with additional services and populations nearby. 
• Supporting NHS London Local Area Team to renew and monitor cross-London evaluation of weekend urgent care provision. 
• Evaluating a local innovative COPD service that will look at activity changes over several years, as well as compare with other similar CCG populations around the country to provide meaningful benchmarks. 
A limited number of named CSU staff will undertake bespoke analysis against the raw HES data producing an aggregate output for customers to support the work above. The data will not be used to link to other datasets other than those provided by the HSCIC. Data will only be used for NHS Health and Social Care use; or by organisations who are commissioned by NHS Health and Social Care for a specific purpose as outlined above. Specific outputs expected: HES allows us to provide intelligence for programmes whose scope demands activity benchmarking against similar health economies or populations in England, not just in the CSU’s area, compare with any service known to have better outcomes or new pathways, or support large scale transformation projects that may impact several commissioners across, for example, the North London area.
